name: Automobile & Auto Parts
description: Heavy-duty frame assemblies, robotic cell enclosures, dynamic assembly line conveyors, and picking workstations engineered to handle high loads and continuous usage.
solution: We provide custom structures using 80x80 & 45x45 heavy aluminium profiles, combined with high-load steel fasteners and mesh guarding to secure robotic cells and automate materials transport.
benefit: Increased safety compliant with automotive standards, zero down-time, and flexible layouts that adapt to new vehicle chassis lines.

name: Electronics & Semiconductor
description: ESD-safe workstations, static-dissipative pipe shelving, PCB handling trolleys, and cleanroom-compliant material flows.
solution: By combining ESD green laminates, grounding cords, and ESD conductive pipes with surface resistances of 10³–10⁵ Ω, we prevent electrostatic damage during component placement and testing.
benefit: Near-zero static discharge risk, modular cell re-layout, and ergonomic parts bins within arms reach.

name: Packaging & Dispatch
description: Custom packaging benches, roller gravity flow feeds, shipping label workstations, and box conveyor systems.
solution: We engineer workstations with built-in bubble wrap rollers, overhead tool bars, integrated scale platforms, and heavy-duty casters to speed up sorting and dispatch.
benefit: 30% reduction in package handling times, organized material layout, and reduced operator physical fatigue.

name: Food & Beverage Processing
description: Clean, rust-proof conveyor belts, anodized aluminium machine guard screens, and modular material sorting trays.
solution: We use clean silver-anodized profiles with smooth nylon filler strips for T-slots to prevent dust accumulation, combined with clear food-grade polycarbonate shielding.
benefit: Hygienic, easy-to-wash structures that comply with food health guidelines without rusting or requiring paint maintenance.

name: Pharmaceuticals & Labs
description: Stainless-steel and cleanroom aluminium workstations, sterile containment hoods, and laboratory test benches.
solution: We build dust-free cleanroom enclosures with integrated HEPA filter hoods, scratch-proof laboratory table tops, and sealed profiles to prevent bacterial deposits.
benefit: Strict compliance with lab clean room guidelines, easy chemical sanitization, and flexible laboratory equipment setups.

name: Warehouse & Logistics
description: High-density FIFO flow racks, materials trolleys, gravity conveyor paths, and sorting bins.
solution: Our heavy-duty steel pipe structures, combined with 40-series roller tracks and inline joints, form robust gravity flow racks that automatically feed bins to the picking face.
benefit: Strict First-In-First-Out rotation, reduced inventory search times, and modular layout scalability.

name: Industrial Engineering
description: Custom linear gantries, multi-axis slide assemblies, pneumatic fixture frames, and test bench housings.
solution: Using high-stiffness T-slot profiles and precision connectors, we construct gantry frames capable of supporting heavy actuator lines and high-speed linear slides.
benefit: High structural rigidity, precise linear slide alignment, and rapid mechanical modifications.

name: General Manufacturing Solutions
description: Shopfloor workstations, industrial display boards, tool racks, visual management panels, and HMI console enclosures.
solution: We build standard 40-series profile structures, display frames, and sheet-metal HMI enclosures with adjustable swing arms for comfortable shopfloor control.
benefit: Standardized shopfloor aesthetics, visual lean factory management, and ergonomic controller positioning.
